## 2. Quality vocabulary, readiness and evidence

- **status_precedence**:
  - missing_input/absent_input (no delivery, or an operand column absent from a supplied chunk that holds required slots)
  - insufficient_history/insufficient_history
  - incomplete_coverage/(governed_gap, observed_empty+no_eligible_observations, null_field, unknown_availability, future_knowledge)
  - available
- **reasons_used**:
  - absent_input
  - governed_gap
  - insufficient_history
  - no_eligible_observations
  - null_field
  - observed_empty
  - unknown_availability
  - future_knowledge
- **reasons_unreachable**:
  - zero_denominator (all denominators are positive by construction)
  - partial_universe
  - empty_universe
  - future_market
  - missing_action_evidence
- **counts**: expected = closure slot count R (or the stated formula); observed = unique closure slots whose required fields, coverage and knowledge qualify
